description: This source file defines the SetPinCodeResponseEvent class, which represents a specific cluster command event related to setting a PIN code response in a Zigbee device simulation. It extends ClusterCommandEvent and constructs a payload with a status byte, indicating the result of the PIN code set operation.

classes.name: SetPinCodeResponseEvent
classes.description: A class representing a Zigbee cluster command event specific to responding with a PIN code set result.

methods.name: SetPinCodeResponseEvent
methods.description: Constructor initializes the event with cluster information and a status byte indicating the result of setting the PIN code.

methods.name: getCommandPayload
methods.description: Returns the command payload as a byte array containing the status.
